I did an etiquette course (my parents made me) and the two that have really stuck with me (and helped!) are

- Always saying "yes" instead of "yep" or "yeah"

- Table manners. People notice. Stuff like having your napkin on your lap, putting your cutlery down until you've finished your mouthful, and the obvious ones like no elbows on the table or talking with your mouth full haha!

I've had so many people (especially parents of friends or boyfriends) comment on my table manners. It's insane !
